title: Webhook ingestion endpoint (any method to /h/{hook_id})
user_story: As an external service, I need to send HTTP requests to a hook URL and have them captured and stored so the hook owner can inspect them later.
description: Implement the core ingestion handler at /h/{hook_id}. This endpoint accepts ANY HTTP method (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, GET) and captures the full request: method, headers, raw body, content length, query string (in path), and source IP. The captured request is stored in SQLite via db.insert_request(). The response is 200 with a JSON confirmation containing the request_id. If the hook doesn't exist, return 404. Source IP is extracted from ConnectInfo<SocketAddr> with the server configured via into_make_service_with_connect_info.

acceptance_criteria.when: sending POST /h/abc123 with headers and a JSON body
acceptance_criteria.then: response is 200 with JSON {"request_id": "<uuid>", "hook_id": "abc123"} and the request is stored in SQLite

acceptance_criteria.when: sending PUT /h/abc123, GET /h/abc123, DELETE /h/abc123, or PATCH /h/abc123
acceptance_criteria.then: each method is captured correctly — the stored request's method field matches the HTTP method used
response is 404 with structured JSON error and suggestion

acceptance_criteria.when: sending a request with multiple headers including duplicates
acceptance_criteria.then: all headers are captured; duplicate header values are joined with ', '

acceptance_criteria.when: sending a request with query parameters (e.g. /h/abc123?foo=bar&baz=1)
acceptance_criteria.then: the query string is captured in the stored request's path field

acceptance_criteria.when: sending a request with an empty body (e.g. GET)
acceptance_criteria.then: the request is stored with empty body and content_length 0

acceptance_criteria.when: sending a request with binary body (non-UTF-8)
acceptance_criteria.then: the body is stored as raw bytes (BLOB) without corruption

acceptance_criteria.given: a hook exists and requests are ingested
acceptance_criteria.when: checking the hook in the database
acceptance_criteria.then: the hook's request_count is incremented for each ingested request
the source_ip field is populated from the TCP connection (ConnectInfo<SocketAddr>)
integration tests verify all acceptance criteria

functions.name: ingest_webhook
functions.signature: pub async fn ingest_webhook(State(state): State<AppState>, ConnectInfo(addr): ConnectInfo<SocketAddr>, Path(hook_id): Path<String>, method: Method, headers: HeaderMap, body: Bytes) -> Result<impl IntoResponse, AppError>
functions.description: Capture any HTTP request to /h/{hook_id} — extract all metadata, store in SQLite, return 200 with request_id

single_binary_checklist.notes: All request data stored in SQLite. Body stored as BLOB. Headers as JSON TEXT. Source IP from TCP connection info.
